scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: CAPYCOPY_LOCAL=1 uv run uvicorn api_server:app --app-dir backend --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && UV_SYSTEM_CERTS=1 uv run pywrangler dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run generate && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R frontend/.output/public/. dist/
scripts.deploy: npm run build && UV_SYSTEM_CERTS=1 uv run pywrangler deploy
scripts.seed:d1: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply capycopy-db --local
